# Mohammad Makki

> AI Solutions Architect and Full-Stack Developer based in Tripoli, Lebanon. Co-founder and Web-Dev Team Lead at CommandNet Solutions. Ships AI products (LLM agents, RAG pipelines, computer vision), Shopify and headless commerce at scale, and automation platforms — 100+ delivered projects since 2019, many under NDA.

This is a single-page portfolio: every section below is an anchor on one document, not a separate page. Contact: makki.51x3@gmail.com · WhatsApp +961 76 556 037. The site is bilingual (English and Arabic with full RTL); the Arabic build is the same URL with the language toggled client-side.

## Selected work

- [Selected work deck](https://mohammad-makki-portfolio.netlify.app/#work): flagship builds, each opening a full case file
- [AI Trading Platform](https://mohammad-makki-portfolio.netlify.app/#work): NDA flagship — MetaTrader-5 ecosystem, FastAPI backend, multi-terminal trade sync, Telegram assistant, admin dashboard, PostgreSQL/Redis/Docker on a hardened VPS
- [Naqua · AI recipe chatbot](https://naquastore.com/): per-product LLM context generating recipes on seafood product pages, Arabic RTL, OpenRouter gateway, Next.js + Laravel
- [Chemigaz](https://chemigaz.com): corporate site for a Lebanese industrial and medical gas supplier, designed and shipped end to end
- [OMIC-AI skincare quiz](https://omicskincare.com/pages/quiz): quiz- and image-based recommendation engine across US and MENA storefronts, English and Arabic
- [Smart Stories](https://smartstories.io): shoppable-stories platform — 20+ story templates plus Shopify GraphQL widgets with KPI tracking
- [Mobily presentation site](https://enthusiastic-wealth-676179.framer.app): animated Framer build with custom code components and a bespoke video playback system
- [Lab & experiments](https://mohammad-makki-portfolio.netlify.app/#lab): 100+ n8n workflow automation platform, AutoScope AI vehicle inspection, an ElizaOS racing agent, an Arabic WhatsApp dietitian, a Solana launch pipeline, a financial-document reader
- [More public builds](https://mohammad-makki-portfolio.netlify.app/#more): shorter engagements, internal tools and early work back to 2019
